name: lemon-index
title: The Lemon Index: what junk cars sell for in the United States
description: Monthly average offer for vehicles that do not drive (from 2015), median offers by make, model, model year and condition (purchases since 2021), and state figures. From vehicle purchases made by The Clunker Junker, LLC, published by Lemondrove.

resources.name: lemon-index-monthly
resources.title: The Lemon Index, monthly
resources.description: Average offer for vehicles that do not drive, and the scrap car price per ton, by month, 2015 to October 2026.

fields.name: lemon_index_usd
fields.description: The Lemon Index: the average offer, in nominal U.S. dollars, for vehicles bought that month that did not drive.

fields.name: scrap_car_usd_per_ton
fields.description: Price per ton paid for scrap cars, nominal U.S. dollars.

fields.name: scrap_measured
fields.description: "yes" when the scrap price was measured from that month's purchases; "no" when too few old cars were bought to measure it and it was estimated from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics scrap index (series WPU1012).

resources.name: offers-by-model
resources.title: Offers by make, model and model year
resources.description: Median offers for 223 models by model year, over every sale and by the condition the seller reported, with sample sizes. Purchases since 2021.

fields.name: sample_size
fields.description: Number of purchases of that model and model year.

fields.name: median_offer_all_conditions_usd
fields.description: Median offer over every purchase, nominal U.S. dollars.

fields.name: median_offer_runs_and_drives_usd
fields.description: Median offer where the seller reported the car runs and drives. Empty where fewer than 5 sold in that condition.

fields.name: median_offer_not_driving_body_intact_usd
fields.description: Median offer where the car did not drive and the seller reported no body damage. Empty where fewer than 5 sold in that condition.

fields.name: median_offer_not_driving_body_damage_usd
fields.description: Median offer where the car did not drive and the seller reported body damage. Empty where fewer than 5 sold in that condition.

resources.name: offers-by-state
resources.title: Offers by state
resources.description: For each state and the District of Columbia: purchases, the average offer for cars that do not drive, and pickup and payment figures. Each row covers the last 90 days, or the last 12 months in states with few sales; the window is in the file.

fields.name: window_days
fields.description: How many days the row covers: 90, or 365 for states with few sales.

fields.name: average_offer_not_driving_usd
fields.description: Average offer for vehicles that did not drive, nominal U.S. dollars.

fields.name: median_days_to_scheduled_pickup
fields.description: Median calendar days from the seller accepting to the scheduled pickup date.

fields.name: pickups_scheduled_within_2_days_pct
fields.description: Share of pickups scheduled within two days of accepting, percent.

fields.name: paid_as_first_accepted_pct
fields.description: Share of sales paid exactly the amount the seller first accepted, percent.
